description: Find the Internet Archive Wayback Machine snapshot of a URL closest to a date (or the latest). Returns snapshot_url and time. Use it to cite a dead page (when check_url says 404) or to show what a page said at a past date.

timestamp.description: Optional target date, YYYYMMDD or YYYYMMDDhhmmss: returns the closest snapshot

name: wayback_snapshot
title: Find an archived copy (Wayback Machine)
